artworks.title: The Fall of the Titans
artworks.description: A Mannerist oil painting in the Statens Museum for Kunst, Copenhagen, showing the overthrow of the Titans in a writhing mass of colossal naked bodies hurled from heaven. The composition embodies the ten-year war Hesiod and Apollodorus place between Olympus and Othrys, ending with the Cyclopes' thunderbolt and the Hundred-Handers' barrage of mountains.

artworks.title: Briareos (Spandrel Figure, Natural History Museum Vienna)
artworks.description: A carved spandrel on the Naturhistorisches Museum in Vienna depicting Briareus, one of the Hundred-Handers Zeus freed from Tartarus to hurl three hundred rocks at once against the Titans. The figure keeps alive the archaic image of the allies who turned the Titanomachy at Hesiod Theogony 617–652.
